generic_implementation_evidence.reason: The failing behavior is controlled only by page-index state, native usability, selected-page masks and the caller OCR configuration. It does not branch on company, source name, physical page literal, year, value, anchor identity or question literal.

frozen_observation.representative_aggregate_pattern: The frozen telemetry includes OCR requests outside the post-ranking selected-page set while no OCR page was generated; this pattern is evaluated only as aggregate code-path evidence, not as a report-specific rule.

symbol_trace.evidence: DocumentPageIndex.load_or_build is called before _rank_page_records and receives the enabled OCR configuration; a cold/incomplete index may therefore request OCR before the question-specific page ranking boundary.

When OCR is enabled, missing MinerU state can rebuild the index and _build_records requests every native-unusable page, rather than only the later ranked-plus-neighbor selected mask. These symbols are evidence context and are frozen from direct edit by the minimal implementation plan.
When prefer_mineru_for_selected_pages is true, the function replaces mineru_auto_generate with true even if the public caller explicitly passed false.
The loader already honors mineru_auto_generate=false after cache lookup and already receives a selected-page boolean mask. It is a frozen no-change control, not the admitted defect.

not_established: need to change page ranking, top-k or neighbor thresholds
